rows.grounds: ablative indicating occasion or incidental reason
past passive participle describing vidyā as having been declared
esoteric knowledge or mantra-teaching revealed in this context
compound qualifying vidyā as difficult to obtain across the three worlds

items.question: On what occasion is a vidyā rare in the three worlds revealed to the beloved?
premises: The revelation occurs by contextual occasion (prasaṅgāt).
What is revealed is a vidyā.
This vidyā is described as rare in the three worlds.
items.inference: Therefore, the teaching incidentally discloses to the beloved a vidyā that is exceptionally difficult to obtain.
uncertainties: The specific referent of vidyā depends on the immediately preceding ritual or doctrinal context.
items.plain_english: O beloved, on this occasion I have told you of a knowledge that is rare in the three worlds.
